share.title.description: Heading of the small box that asks the person to share Tabsend with a friend or coworker. “Tabsend” is the product name.

share.body.credit.message: Built by a dad to support his family. Share it, and get $5 off your next payment when a friend subscribes (once a year, however many friends join).
share.body.credit.description: Short text in the share box for people on Tabsend's own service. “Built by a dad” is the maker speaking about himself. $5 is US dollars. The credit is given once a year however many friends join; keep that.

share.body.plain.message: Built by a dad to support his family. If you like it, would you share it with a coworker or friend?
share.body.plain.description: Short text in the share box for people who run their own relay, so no credit is offered. “Built by a dad” is the maker speaking about himself.

share.expanded.credit.message: Tabsend was built by a dad to support his family. If you like it, would you share it with a coworker or friend? It's not for everyone, but I bet you have a good idea who else would find it useful. As a thank you, you'll get $5 off your next payment when a friend subscribes. That's once a year, however many friends join.
share.expanded.credit.description: Longer text shown after “Read more” in the share box, for people on Tabsend's own service. First person, the maker speaking. $5 is US dollars, once a year however many friends join; keep that.

share.expanded.plain.message: Tabsend was built by a dad to support his family. If you like it, would you share it with a coworker or friend? It's not for everyone, but I bet you have a good idea who else would find it useful.
share.expanded.plain.description: Longer text shown after “Read more” in the share box, for people who run their own relay. First person, the maker speaking. No credit is mentioned.

share.button.description: Button in the share box and the name of the matching row in Settings. For people on Tabsend's service it opens the Tabsend account website's share page; otherwise it copies a sentence to share.

share.more.description: Link in the share box that shows the longer text. Short.

share.less.description: Link in the share box that hides the longer text again. Short.

share.dismiss.description: Spoken label (for screen readers) of the close button on the share box. It has no visible text.

share.copied.description: Short confirmation shown after the sentence to share was copied to the clipboard.

share.copy.failed.message: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
share.copy.failed.description: Shown when copying the sentence to share did not work.

share.text.message: Tabsend sends a link from your computer to your phone, or the other way. https://tabsend.org
share.text.description: The sentence that is copied when someone taps Share Tabsend, ready to paste into a message. Keep the web address exactly as it is.

share.help.heading.description: Heading of the Settings section with the Share, Rate and feedback rows. Short.

share.help.share.description: Row in Settings under “Help Tabsend”: share Tabsend with a friend or coworker.

share.help.rate.description: Row in Settings under “Help Tabsend”: opens the store page to leave a rating. Shown only once a store link exists.

share.help.feedback.description: Row in Settings under “Help Tabsend”: opens an email to the maker. “Me” is the maker speaking.
